actions.add_contact_to_list.description: Adds a single contact to an INBOX contact list. Creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing contact and ensures it is part of the list.
Email address of the contact to add (e.g. jane@example.com).
actions.add_contact_to_list.props.listId: Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.
actions.create_campaign.description: Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a saved newsletter to one or more contact lists.
actions.create_campaign.props.lists.desc: Select one or more INBOX contact lists. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.
actions.create_campaign.props.newsletter: The ID of the saved newsletter to send in the campaign. You can find newsletter IDs by using the "List Newsletters" action or by looking at the URL when editing a newsletter in INBOX (e.g. https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, where 12345 is the newsletter ID).
actions.create_campaign.props.notifyWhen: If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign finishes sending.
If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign starts sending.
actions.create_campaign.props.plannedTim: Optional. When to send the campaign. Leave empty to use INBOX defaults. Use a future date/time.
actions.create_campaign.props.senderAcco: The verified sender the campaign emails are sent from. Add senders under Settings > Senders in INBOX.
actions.create_contact_list.description: Creates a new contact list in INBOX where you can later add contacts.
actions.create_contact_list.props.groupI: Optional. Place the list inside this group to keep things organised. Leave empty to keep it ungrouped.
actions.create_contact_list.props.legisl: Legal basis for collecting these contacts. Pick the regulation your audience is covered by; this affects what consent text INBOX shows.
actions.create_contact_list.props.listNa: Name of the new contact list (e.g. "Newsletter Subscribers").
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.send_transactional_email.descrip: Sends a one-off transactional email through INBOX Notify (e.g. password reset, receipt, welcome).
actions.send_transactional_email.props.c: Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `#key#` placeholders in your HTML (e.g. `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
actions.send_transactional_email.props.f: Verified sender email. The domain must already be authenticated in INBOX Notify, otherwise the email will be rejected.
The display name shown to recipients (e.g. "Acme Support").
actions.send_transactional_email.props.h: The HTML body of the email. You can reference INBOX merge fields with `#fieldName#` and provide values in Custom Fields below.
actions.unsubscribe_contact.description: Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed so they stop receiving campaigns from INBOX. You can also mark them as Hard Bounce or Spam Reported.
actions.unsubscribe_contact.props.contac: Select the contact to update. Contacts are listed under Contacts in your INBOX dashboard.
actions.unsubscribe_contact.props.status: The status to apply to the contact.
actions.update_contact.description: Updates an existing INBOX contact. You can add or replace tags and set custom field values.
actions.update_contact.props.contactId.d: Select the contact to update. Contacts are listed under Contacts in your INBOX dashboard.
actions.update_contact.props.tags.descri: Optional. Tags to attach to the contact (e.g. "vip", "newsletter"). Leave empty to keep existing tags.
auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.
auth.username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.
description: Email marketing and transactional email automation with INBOX (useinbox.com). Manage contacts, lists, campaigns, and react to delivery events.
triggers.email_bounced.description: Triggers when a transactional email permanently bounces (hard bounce) — the recipient address does not exist or is blocked.
triggers.email_clicked.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link inside a transactional email.
triggers.email_opened.description: Triggers each time a transactional email is opened by the recipient. Fires on every open (not unique).
triggers.email_spam_reported.description: Triggers when a recipient marks a transactional email as spam in their inbox.
triggers.new_campaign.description: Triggers when a new campaign is created in your INBOX account.
triggers.new_contact.description: Triggers when a new contact is added to your INBOX account (through a form, manual entry, import, or API).
